name: Consent-gated voice cloning
objectives: Synthesize speech in a reference voice from a 10-15 s clip, locally, within 8 GB unified memory
Refuse any clone without consent bound to the exact reference file
tasks: Register consent for a reference clip
Clone a voice for a short and a multi-paragraph text
Verify watermark and provenance manifest on the output
benchmarks: Peak RSS stays under 6 GB during synthesis
Unconsented and revoked references are rejected 100% of the time
Watermark detected on lossless output; false-positive rate measured on unmarked audio
safety_constraints: No cloning without a consent record bound to the reference file hash
Every output carries a watermark, sidecar manifest, and ledger entry
No impersonation of real people without their consent
monetization_opportunities: Licensed voice narration for consenting talent
